messages:
anya: Quick check — we're standardizing how client libs map API errors to exceptions and attach request_id to logs. Question: should 401 always map to AuthenticationError (retryable=false) and 429 to RateLimitError (retryable=true with backoff)? Also streaming disconnects: wrap stream-level failures in StreamReadError and include the last_request_id? cc @sam @kevin

sam: +1 on 401 -> AuthenticationError non-retry. For 429 treat as transient if `Retry-After` header present; otherwise exponential backoff. Include request_id from `x-request-id` (or `request-id`) in the exception object. Example: `raise RateLimitError("quota exceeded", request_id=req_id, retry_after=ts)`

kevin: For ergonomics across languages: Python should subclass a common RedwoodError so users can `except RedwoodError`, JS/TS should attach `.meta` (object) with `{ requestId, httpStatus, serverCode }` and set `error.name` to a typed name. Avoid throwing raw HTTPResponse objects.

leo: Streaming note: when server returns a partial stream or `x-stream-status: incomplete`, surface a `StreamIncompleteError` that includes partial tokens or last event and the request_id. That makes postmortems easier.

anya: Sounds good. On debug logs — we want a concise structured line with request_id, model, token counts and latency. Proposed: `debug("generation", request_id=req, model=model_id, tokens_in=12, tokens_out=87, latency_ms=123)` — keep prompt text masked by default.

sam: Agreed, and make verbose debug opt-in (SDK flag `enable_debug_verbose`). For privacy-sensitive orgs we should redact prompt by default and surface token counts only.

kevin: I'll draft a small error meta shape for the clients:
```# python
class RedwoodError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, meta=None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.meta = meta or {}

# example usage
raise AuthenticationError("invalid token", meta={"request_id": req_id, "http_status": 401})
```
and for JS: `throw Object.assign(new Error(msg), { name: 'AuthenticationError', meta: { requestId, httpStatus } })`

deploy-bot: PR 1427 merged to canary (clientlib/errors) :rocket:

anya: Nice — @kevin can you add a README snippet showing how to catch RateLimitError and read `error.meta.requestId`? Also include one-line guidance about streaming errors containing partial content + request_id.

kevin: Will do. Draft PR link: https://github.com/redwood/clientlib/pull/1428 (wip)

leo: One more operational suggestion: centralize retry policy in a middleware so we can tweak without language-specific releases. Maybe expose a policy object that reads service hints (Retry-After, `x-retry-policy`). :thumbsup:

sam: I'll open an infra ticket to document the canonical retry policy and headers we support. Thanks all — this gives me enough to update the SDK checklist for exceptions + logs.
